---


Fixed the nested form issue. In `app/update/page.tsx`, the Calendar component was inside a `<form>`, and the Calendar’s modal also contains a `<form>`, which caused nested forms.

**What I changed:**
- Moved the Calendar component outside the form element
- The form now only wraps the Notes & Sweet Nothings and Shared Tasks & Lists sections, plus the submit button
- The Calendar section is rendered separately after the form closes

This resolves the hydration error. The Calendar’s modal form is now rendered outside the parent form, so there’s no nesting. Functionality is unchanged—the form still submits notes and tasks, and the Calendar can add events independently.
